fix(postgres): bind runnable lease audit semantics

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-53
  description: |-
    Bind each durable runnable-lease event kind to its closed evidence class so alternate SQL writers cannot create semantically contradictory audit records.
    
    Refuse migration rollback whenever any runnable-lease event exists, including a post-migration generation-1 reservation, because the immutable event cannot be proven synthetic and would otherwise be discarded.
    
    Extend migration acceptance to reject every mismatched event/evidence pair and to prove rollback rejects a newly committed held reservation.
